messages:
Luca (EMEA SDR): Morning team, happy to be here! I'm missing HubSpot access to the EMEA queues, Dialpad EU number is pending, and the EMEA cheat-sheet mentioned in the welcome email isn't in my bundle. Who do I ping for these?

onboarding-bot: Welcome Luca (EMEA SDR) to #sales! Buddy assigned: Hana. Check your onboarding checklist in email.

Hannah (Sales Ops): Welcome Luca! I sent HubSpot invite to luca@redwood.ai and added you to the 'EMEA - Inbound' and 'EMEA - Outbound' queues. What office are you in for printed materials?

Luca (EMEA SDR): Madrid office. Also the Dialpad invite says "number assignment pending"  any ETA?

Ivan (IT): @Luca I filed TEL-473 for the +34 DID. Telecom estimating 24h. In the meantime I've enabled the web softphone so you can dial out. If you need caller ID set to 'Redwood - EMEA' tell me now.

Luca (EMEA SDR): Yes please set caller ID to 'Redwood - EMEA'. And the cheat-sheet link in the welcome email pointed to US plays. Can someone add the EMEA quick-sell?

Rae (Enablement): Added EMEA Quick-Sell v1 to your onboarding bundle and uploaded localized opener snippets (Spanish and English). Link: https://redwood.link/emea-quick-sell (also in Drive > Sales > EMEA). Short tip: lead with regulatory relief then mention latency.

Hannah (Sales Ops): Printed A6 quick-cards ordered for Madrid (qty 30). Mailroom will tag for pickup. printing-bot: job #PRINT-462 created.

Luca (EMEA SDR): HubSpot shows the queues now, thanks. Softphone works but calls aren't logging to HubSpot activity.

Ivan (IT): Reconnected Dialpad <> HubSpot integration and refreshed your OAuth token. Try a test call and check activity feed. If still missing, send a screenshot.

Luca (EMEA SDR): Test call logged correctly now  activity shows caller and duration. All good. One last question: who OKs localized email templates that reference EU customers?

Hannah (Sales Ops): Legal approval required for customer names/logos; otherwise pre-approved EMEA snippets are fine. Email legal-ops@redwood.com and CC sales-ops. They usually respond within 48h.

Luca (EMEA SDR): Awesome thanks everyone for the quick help. I'll shadow Hana tomorrow at 10:00 CET. :party_parrot:
